title: Agglomerations of the Roman world, 8th c. BCE – 15th c. CE (ArkeoGIS; Hanson 2016 cities, Jullien 2023–24), Nakala
describe: Excavated towns of the Roman world (Hanson's urban sites and Jullien's urban geography), with the period in which each documented characteristic (settlement, public buildings, walls, water works…) starts and ends; an undetermined end is left open, never filled in.
datingLabel: start and end periods of the site's documented characteristics (ArkeoGIS)
